#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; layout(location = 0) in vec4 aRectPoint; layout(location = 1) in vec4 aPointInfo; layout(location = 2) in vec2 AAInfo; layout(location = 3) in vec3 aColor; uniform mat4 uProjectionMatrix; out vec2 fragCoord; out vec3 fragColor; out float innerRadius; out float alphaByWidth; void main(void) { vec3 _dummy = aColor; gl_Position = uProjectionMatrix * vec4(aPointInfo.xy + aRectPoint.xy * aPointInfo.zw, 0.0, 1.0); fragCoord = vec2(aRectPoint.z, aRectPoint.w); innerRadius = AAInfo.x; alphaByWidth = AAInfo.y; }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; in vec2 fragCoord; in float innerRadius; in float alphaByWidth; vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5); const float radius = 0.5; out float FragColor; void main(void) { float dist = distance(center, fragCoord.xy); float alpha = alphaByWidth; if (dist > innerRadius) { alpha *= (1.0 - (dist - innerRadius) / (0.5 - innerRadius)); } FragColor = alpha; }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; layout(location = 0) in vec4 aRectPoint; layout(location = 1) in vec4 aPointInfo; layout(location = 2) in vec2 AAInfo; layout(location = 3) in vec3 vertexColor; uniform mat4 uProjectionMatrix; out vec2 fragCoord; out float innerRadius; out float alphaByWidth; out vec3 fragColor; void main(void) { gl_Position = uProjectionMatrix * vec4(aPointInfo.xy + aRectPoint.xy * aPointInfo.zw, 0.0, 1.0); fragCoord = vec2(aRectPoint.z, aRectPoint.w); innerRadius = AAInfo.x; alphaByWidth = AAInfo.y; fragColor = vertexColor; }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; uniform vec4 uInputColor; in vec2 fragCoord; in float innerRadius; in float alphaByWidth; in vec3 fragColor; vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5); const float radius = 0.5; out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { float dist = distance(center, fragCoord.xy); float alpha = alphaByWidth; if (dist > innerRadius) { alpha *= (1.0 - (dist - innerRadius) / (0.5 - innerRadius)); } FragColor = vec4(fragColor, 1.0) * alpha * uInputColor.a; }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; layout(location = 0) in vec2 aVertex; out vec2 vUV; void main(void) { vUV = aVertex * 0.5 + 0.5; gl_Position = vec4(aVertex.xy, 0.0, 1.0); }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; uniform sampler2D uSrcOverTexture; uniform sampler2D uMaxTexture; uniform vec4 uInputColor; in vec2 vUV; out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { float alpha = texture(uMaxTexture, vUV).r * uInputColor.a; if (alpha <= 0.0) discard; vec4 srcOverTexel = texture(uSrcOverTexture, vUV); if (srcOverTexel.a <= 0.0) discard; vec3 color = srcOverTexel.rgb / srcOverTexel.a; FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0) * alpha; }

paint_model.evidence: derived from the captured native shader source, blend state, and Mesa readbacks
paint_model.final_composite: C = (P / A) * (M * input_alpha), when A > 0; the GL_RG8 target R is premultiplied output color, not standalone alpha
paint_model.max_mask: M = max_i(alpha_i) per covered pixel (GL_MAX, ONE/ONE)
paint_model.scope: This is the observed synthetic native RTV3 paint path, not a saved Drawing or production admission claim.
paint_model.source_over: P_i = c_i * alpha_i; P = P_i + P_prev * (1 - alpha_i); A = alpha_i + A_prev * (1 - alpha_i)
paint_model.uniform_rgb_reduction: when every record has the same RGB c, P/A = c, so final RGB is c * M * input_alpha; same-RGB overlap should preserve final color while differing RGB exposes source-over normalization
